description: Use the validated rebuild-and-diff technique (~15-20s/rebuild): checkout each candidate, rebuild, run quicksort/append/reverse, diff reductions_remaining vs the committed golden, to name the single culprit commit in the ~250-commit range between rebless #1 (0aa8dc0eb) and rebless #2 (2479a69fd). Output + all allocation counters were byte-identical across the jump, so this isolates pure codegen-shape churn.
